    app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"

    metadata:
      
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: api
        app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
        managed-by: platform
        tenant: t1
    spec:
      
      serviceAccountName: shop-api
      initContainers:
        - command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - "true"
          image: busybox:1.36
          name: wait-db
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "reg.onprem.example/platform/t1/shop-api@sha256:fcb75f691c8b0414d670ae570240cbf95502cc18a9ba57e982ecac589760a186"
          command:
            - /http-echo
          args:
            - -listen=:3000
            - -text=api ok
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
              name: http
          env:
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: shop-db-rw
            - name: DB_PORT
              value: "5432"
            - name: DB_USER
              value: app
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  key: password
                  name: shop-db-app
            - name: JWT_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  key: JWT_SECRET
                  name: shop-secrets
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 512Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: http
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /etc/app
              name: cfg-app-config
              readOnly: true
            - mountPath: /etc/tls
              name: sec-tls
              readOnly: true
            - mountPath: /var/cache/app
              name: pvc-cache
        -
          command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - sleep infinity

            claimName: api-cache

        managed-by: platform
        tenant: t1

      serviceAccountName: shop-api

        - name: app
          image: "busybox:1.36"

            - sh
            - -c
            - echo migrated

metadata:

    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "nightly"
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  suspend: true
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      template:
        metadata:
          
          labels:
            app.kubernetes.io/component: nightly
            app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
            managed-by: platform
            tenant: t1

          serviceAccountName: shop-api
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: app
              image: "reg.onprem.example/platform/t1/shop-api@sha256:fcb75f691c8b0414d670ae570240cbf95502cc18a9ba57e982ecac589760a186"
              command:
                - /http-echo
              args:
                - -version
---
# Source: app/templates/ingress.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  rules:
    - host: "shop.example.com"
      http:
        paths:
          - path: "/"
            pathType: Prefix
            backend: { service: { name: shop-web, port: { number: 80 } } }
---
# Source: app/templates/cnpg.yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: shop-db
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  instances: 1
  imageName: "ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16"
  storage: { size: "20Gi" }
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 1Gi
    requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 1Gi
  bootstrap:
    initdb: { database: "shop", owner: "app" }
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      wal_level: logical
---
# Source: app/templates/externalsecret.yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: shop-secrets
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
    name: vault
  target:
    name: shop-secrets
  data:
    - secretKey: "JWT_SECRET"
      remoteRef:
        key: "shop/app"
        property: "JWT_SECRET"
---
# Source: app/templates/externalsecret.yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: shop-tls
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
    name: vault
  target:
    name: shop-tls
    template: { type: "kubernetes.io/tls" }
  data:
    - secretKey: "tls.crt"
      remoteRef:
        key: "shop/tls"
        property: "tls.crt"
    - secretKey: "tls.key"
      remoteRef:
        key: "shop/tls"
        property: "tls.key"
